title: Additive quasi-coherent quotient of consecutive nilpotent-units kernels
statement: Let $X$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $E_j$ denote the kernel sheaves of [def-sc-reduction-units-power-kernel]. For each $j\geq0$ there exist a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $F_j$ and a short exact complex of abelian etale sheaves $0\to E_{j+1}\to E_j\to (F_j)_{\mathrm{Et}}\to0$ [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. The associated additive sheaf is lifted sectionwise to the coefficient universe of $\mathbf G_m$. No Noetherian or finite nilpotence assumption is required.

proof.text: Use the explicit module F_j=N^(j+1)/N^(j+2) and its proved quasi-coherence instance.

Use the constructed kernel-lift inclusion e_j and its proved monicity. In the abelian category of etale sheaves let S=ShortComplex.cokernelSequence e_j. ShortComplex.cokernelSequence_exact, monicity of e_j, and epimorphic cokernel projection give S.ShortExact. Its first two objects are definitionally E_(j+1), E_j, so their isomorphisms are identities.
The specified cokernel comparison identifies S.X₃ with the lifted etale sheaf of the specified F_j. Package F_j, its quasi-coherence instance, S, short exactness, and the three isomorphisms.
